Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take the next dose with your next meal or snack as directed. Storage Instructions: Store the product at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always seek guidance from your healthcare professional for complete details about this product and your individual health requirements. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions to access the offer.
